reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs (Sections 10.4.1 and 6.15) contain no solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant — Section 10.4.1 addresses IP/confidentiality rights from personnel and Section 6.15 only disclaims side payments, neither of which restricts hiring or solicitation.

Absence of any non-solicit binding us matches the rule's preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so no redline or counterparty comment is expected; the empty redline and absent comment are correct.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable heuristics here — there is no non-solicit clause whose duration or carve-out could be measured, so they do not undermine the compliant classification.
Finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue; rationale accurately describes the search performed and the nearest related provisions.
